name: Cloudflare AI Gateway
summary: Cloudflare AI Gateway is a proxy that runs on Cloudflare's network in front of model providers. It adds analytics, logging, response caching, rate limiting, retries and model fallbacks. Requests can use your own provider keys or Cloudflare's Unified Billing credits.
facts: Core features free on all plans
5% fee on purchased credits, no markup on inference
Workers AI, OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Replicate and others
Caching, rate limiting, retries, fallbacks, logs, analytics
goodFor: Caching repeated prompts at the edge
watchOut: Log storage and retention depend on Workers plan
Unified Billing adds 5% to credit purchases
